name: zzQ2_nation_walk

tests.name: the harness can actually drive the Dog -- these are walks, not stationary readings

detail.note: 3 s of AddMovementInput toward the second waypoint before the route is judged. PEAK SPEED separates the cases and displacement alone cannot: full walk speed with no advance is BLOCKED GEOMETRY and is a finding about that place, while a peak near zero is the harness and withholds the route. The harness counts as proven by any one nation driving.

tests.name: no walk ended because the DOG disappeared -- a pawn destroyed part-way along an avenue is a streaming finding about that avenue, not a harness failure

detail.note: alive() collapses 'the world ended' and 'the Dog was destroyed' into one None, and the message used to blame the world for both. A torn-down PIE says nothing about the route; a Dog destroyed 5 m into a 485 m avenue is the route. last_z against the leg's own floor is the discriminator -- far below means it fell through unstreamed ground

tests.name: every nation's walk started with the Dog standing at the gate end of its route

errors.ICARUS: the Dog never got moving: 0.0 uu in 3 s at a peak of only 0.0 uu/s. Route NOT judged; this is the harness or the character, not the route.
